title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Fresh Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Fresh Prefilled Pod Kit is engineered for vapers seeking exceptional longevity, consistent performance, and unparalleled flavour purity. Designed to deliver a premium Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience, this kit pairs a substantial 1000mAh built-in battery with a clever high-capacity e-liquid reservoir. Capable of providing up to 10,000 puffs* between replacements, it is a highly reliable device that easily accommodates all-day use while offering rapid Type-C charging to minimise downtime (please note: a USB-C charging cable is not included). A standout feature of this device is its revolutionary INSTA-JUICED technology and patented 0+10ml freshness-locking design. This system keeps the 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid perfectly sealed within the 10ml refill container until you are ready to assemble the kit, ensuring absolute flavour purity and preventing coil degradation during transit. Upon removing the red silicone plug and connecting the 2ml pod to the 10ml container, the e-liquid is released. It is vital to let the assembled unit stand for five minutes to allow the liquid to fully saturate the COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil. This advanced heating element guarantees rapid, even vapourisation for consistently dense vapour and highly accurate flavour reproduction from the first draw to the last. With no buttons or complex menus to navigate, the Dojo Blast 10K Fresh operates via a highly responsive inhale-activation mechanism. Simply draw on the mouthpiece to experience a smooth, satisfying MTL vape. The system also utilises Vaporesso's industry-leading SSS Leak Resistance technology, keeping your device clean and your e-liquid securely stored. When the reservoir is empty, the battery unit offers expansive cross-compatibility and can be seamlessly paired with any replacement refill pack from the original BLAST10K, BLAST10K PRO, and BLAST 30K PRO series. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast 10K Fresh Kit: Remove the device, the 2ml pod, and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for five minutes to allow the e-liquid to move into the pod and fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into the battery device and inhale to vape. Available Kit Flavours: Berry Lemonade - A bright fusion pairing British Malling Centenary Strawberry and Tulameen Raspberry with zesty Meyer Lemon. Blackcurrant GB - Blends the rich taste of British-grown Blackcurrants with a sugary, confectionery-inspired sweet shop finish. Blue Razz GB - Combines sweet and tangy Blue Raspberry notes with a chewy, confectionery-inspired profile. Matcha Strawberry - A unique, cafe-style pairing of British Malling Centenary Strawberry and earthy Japanese Okumidori Matcha with a soft milky finish. Pina Colada - Captures a classic tropical cocktail using Costa Rican MD2 Pineapple, creamy Coconut milk, and a soft Vanilla finish. Rhubarb Custard Sweet - A nostalgic, balanced blend contrasting sharp British Rhubarb with smooth, creamy Vanilla custard. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
